exposure.needed: whether the environment uses IPsec with single key configuration (+ sign in secrets)

original.statement: IPsec single key support (indicated by the + sign in secrets) has been removed; per-tunnel keys are now always used regardless of the + sign's presence.

decision.reason: [ev-a152c8cea30c] says only that IPsec single-key support is removed and that per-tunnel keys are now used whether or not the secret contains a `+` sign. It does not name any Helm value, flag or field that shows whether an environment uses IPsec or which key mode it uses. Exposure depends on what is inside the IPsec key secret, which static configuration does not show, so an undecidable condition with an environment-visibility gap fits. One caveat: the parenthetical in "needed" is loosely worded. The evidence implies that the exposed case is a secret without the `+` sign.
